Submit task to swarm.

Calls `POST /api/v1/intake` on the Intake Gateway with:
- project_id: {{project}}
- title: {{title}}
- source: opencode

Set INTAKE_GATEWAY_URL (default http://localhost:8081) for the gateway base URL.

Example: `/swarm sdp_lab "Add user authentication"`
